Why we exist

Built to hunt for opportunity — and protect what you've built.

We named this after the wolf on purpose. A wolf hunts — but it also protects its own.

Lykos Intelligence is built to do both for small and growing businesses: surface the opportunities you'd otherwise miss, and safeguard the operational and financial ground you've already won. We're building this for the businesses in our own region first — not enterprise, not bloat. If it makes this community's businesses stronger, it's doing its job.

Backed by a fund? Lykos also gives fund admins roll-up visibility across portfolio companies — read-only, with zero disruption to how you run your own business.

No public signup — every account starts with a real conversation. Tell us about your business and we'll set you up.
